newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar Navigation drags down Qatar stocks.
newsitem.headline: Qatar Navigation drags down Qatar stocks.

text.p: A sharp drop in Qatar Navigation's share price sent the unofficial Qatar stock market down one percent in the week to Thursday, brokers said.

"The decline in Qatar Navigation's share was due to the disappointment by investors who had expected, based on rumours, bonus shares in addition to cash dividends by the company," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, assistant general manager of treasury and investments at the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ).
The 90-riyal plunge in Navigation's shares pulled CBQ's 18-share index down to a 125.14-point close against the previous week's 126.40-point end, Shakarchi said.

Qatar Navigation finished at 670 riyals on Thursday against 760 last week after declaring a payout equal to 45 percent of capital. The dividend was the same as that for 1995 even though net profit rose more than 10 percent to 77.68 million riyals. This had fuelled expectations of a bonus issue by the company.
During the week, six shares rose, three fell and nine were unchanged.
The losers, besides Qatar Navigation, were the CBQ, which shed two riyals to 348, and Qatar Islamic Bank, which dipped one riyal to 131.
The gainers included Doha Bank Ltd, which rose five riyals to 305, and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar, which added 10 riyals to 245.
Qatar General Insurance and Qatar Cinema gained five riyals each to 620 and 190 respectively and Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Co added one riyal to 58.
Market leaders Qatar National Bank and Qatar Insurance were unchanged at 635 and 535 riyals respectively.
